verdict.label: INCONCLUSIVE (underpowered), not FAIL: pooling doubles days (300-385) but prereg_gate still BLOCKs all 9 cells (600-1944 needed). 0 of 9 survive; pooled net -0.044 to -0.156 % per trade at 0.14 %, lowest Holm p 0.19.

why: Every pooled cell has net below zero at 0.14 %: london k 1.0 n 374 net -0.156 % [-0.288, -0.024]; ny k 0.5 n 458 net -0.044 % [-0.185, +0.097].
ETH alone looks like BTC: net -0.122 to +0.011 %; the only cell at or above zero (ny k 0.5, +0.011 %) has Holm p 1.0.
